name: Lord Salisbury
role: British Conservative leader and prime minister
bio: The British Conservative leader appeared in the Cow Boy's foreign news in 1885 as the new prime minister facing chaotic foreign and Irish policy, and he was reported to want an alliance with Germany against Russia. In February 1886 the paper reported that Gladstone had defeated him and was forming a new cabinet.
